backend/main.mo: Defines the main backend actor with user data maps, domain types (tasks, notes, timers, profiles, rewards), storage mixins, and state for timers, backgrounds, and daily summaries.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a simple migration module that passes through user level data unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, affected frontend files, components used, and associated test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-like summary mapping frontend file paths to short functional descriptions of each component or module.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining color tokens and light/dark mode styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entrypoint defining metadata, icons, root mount node, and script loader for the frontend app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication, theme, background persistence, and tabbed navigation across major sections.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundSettin: Background customization component supporting coin-gated uploads, camera capture, rarity-tier purchases, and background selection.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer displaying credits, year, and link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with theme toggle, authentication handling, and user avatar dropdown using Internet Identity and profile data.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login landing page showing app features and triggering Internet Identity login with error handling.
frontend/src/components/NotesSection.tsx: Notes manager supporting creation, editing, deletion, image uploads, and voice recording using backend blob storage.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSection.t: User profile page allowing bio edits, avatar upload, name changes, and level progression actions.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Onboarding dialog for creating a new user profile with name and optional bio, granting welcome coins.
frontend/src/components/ReminderNotifica: Background component that polls upcoming reminders and triggers local notifications once per reminder.
frontend/src/components/RemindersSection: UI for creating reminders, validating inputs, submitting to backend, and listing upcoming reminders with formatted times.
frontend/src/components/StopwatchSection: Persistent stopwatch that restores state from backend, tracks elapsed time, and supports start, pause, and reset actions.
frontend/src/components/TimerSection.tsx: Pomodoro/custom timer with persistence, notifications, session recording, and coin/streak integration.
frontend/src/components/timetable/DoneTo: Checkbox that toggles and displays whether a timetable entry is marked done for the current day.
frontend/src/components/timetable/EditTi: Dialog component for editing a timetable entry’s title and activity type, submitting updates via mutation.
frontend/src/components/timetable/Timeta: Dialog showing a timetable entry’s last 6 months of completion history with statistics and daily status list.
frontend/src/components/TimetableSection: CRUD interface for daily timetable entries with dialogs for editing, deleting, and viewing completion history.
frontend/src/components/TodoSection.tsx: Task management UI allowing creation, listing, and completion of tasks with priority and subject fields.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication state using Internet Identity, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating profile, coins, backgrounds, and timetable-related backend data.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base setup defining light and dark theme variables and applying global styles.
frontend/src/lib/NotificationManager.ts: Utility for displaying toast notifications for timers and reminders and managing browser notification permissions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrorMessage.t: Maps backend error strings to user-friendly messages for display in the UI.
frontend/src/utils/timetableDates.ts: Provides helpers to generate YYYY-MM-DD date keys, convert bigint timestamps to date keys, and check if a timestamp is today.
frontend/src/utils/timetableHistory.ts: Generates date ranges and lists for the past 6 months and maps tick history to day-level completion data.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, storing/retrieving them in sessionStorage, and managing persisted URL state.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes the project's planned features, constraints, known issues, and current enhancement requirements for the timetable app.
